summary: Black Isle's combat-forward Forgotten Realms Infinity Engine RPG series, with Beamdog's Enhanced Edition for the first game and a community Enhanced Edition mod route for the second.

entries.title: Icewind Dale
entries.definitive_edition: Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition on Windows

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with Enhanced Edition improvements.

primary.why: Enhanced Edition includes the original game plus Heart of Winter and Trials of the Luremaster, adds modern UI/renderer support, new items/classes/kits, and is the most complete and practical archive route. Windows is the best capture/mod route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition on Windows with current Beamdog patches.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced Edition changes systems with BG2-derived kits/classes; purists may compare with the original, but no exclusive content requires a secondary route.

entries.title: Icewind Dale II
entries.definitive_edition: Windows release with Red Chimera Enhanced Edition mod

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows release and optional Red Chimera Enhanced Edition mod.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with community modernization.

primary.version: Icewind Dale II Windows release with Red Chimera Enhanced Edition mod
primary.why: No official Beamdog-style Enhanced Edition exists because the source code was lost. The best current route is the Windows release with the community Red Chimera Enhanced Edition mod, which streamlines gameplay, rebalances systems, and adds content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release from a current storefront/preservation build, then install the Red Chimera Group Icewind Dale II: Enhanced Edition mod if you want the modernized route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Enhanced Edition route is a community mod, not an official remaster; purists may prefer the unmodified Windows release.
